title: Symbolic structural identifiability analysis of ODE models in Julia
text: A step by step tutorial, published in the Bulletin of Mathematical Biology, on deciding from the model equations alone which parameters of an ODE model can be recovered from the observed outputs, with a reproducibility package containing the pinned Julia environment and worked examples.

title: ML Selection Framework: companion notebooks
text: Six Jupyter notebooks accompanying the article Machine Learning Algorithm Selection: A Unified Framework from Classical Methods to Foundation Models, accepted for publication in the Journal of Intelligent & Fuzzy Systems (not yet published). They are educational examples of the methods, selection guidelines, and evaluation protocol described in the article, not experimental results. MIT license; v1.0.0 archived as doi:10.5281/zenodo.19599148.

title: SIRA: epidemic and risk awareness model
text: Model implementation, numerical simulations, stability, bifurcation, and sensitivity analyses, and figure scripts accompanying the BIOMATH article on long-term coexistence of epidemics and risk awareness.

title: Calculus and Matrix Methods for Data Science
text: An applied introduction with Python: calculus, series, linear algebra, and multivariable calculus, with each concept worked by hand and then implemented, verified, and visualized in Python.

title: Student Guidelines for Responsible Use of Generative AI
text: A one page guide giving students a practical framework for using generative AI in coursework while preserving learning, integrity, privacy, and responsibility.

title: Code and notebooks
text: Research code and course materials are released through GitHub as projects are published.
